WITH trader_type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    transaction_count,
    transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM trader_type_counts
),
averaged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(transaction_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM with_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(transaction_count) AS sum_of_counts,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(transaction_count - average_count) AS average_excess_count
FROM averaged
WHERE transaction_count > average_count;
